EXECUTIVE LUXURY FULLY FURNISHED STUDIO APARTMENT

My Property Box are delighted to offer to the letting market an executive studio apartment situated in the heart of Stockton. The property is presented and decorated to the very highest standard. Accommodation comprises of Open plan Living Space, Fully Fitted Kitchen including Washer, Dryer, Fridge Freezer, Electric Oven with Gas Hob, Bathroom with Shower, There is also a separate Lobby area perfect for storage. Gas Central Heating. Off Street Parking. Property Excludes all Utilities and also Council Tax
